column6: NCT07140913 is the adjunctive arm of the same BALSAM mania programme as NCT06929273, NCT06951698 and NCT06951711, and the registry indexes it under both Mania and Bipolar Disorder where the other three carry Mania alone. The book prices this work on the Mania layer, whose pool is the 12-month bipolar I population; a Bipolar Disorder row beside it would hold the same patients twice and split one programme across two gates.

NCT06864026, the psoriatic arthritis twin of NCT06857942: the joint disease belongs to ixekizumab, not to tirzepatide

NCT06937086 and NCT06937099 study mirikizumab alongside tirzepatide in ulcerative colitis and Crohn's patients whose conditions read 'Obesity or Overweight'.
